column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 23 (M23023): Zhaohui menahan lorong; Vector, Ruchey, Welrod & Harpsy melawan Igla.
# Tetap Inggris: Zhaohui, Jiangyu, Daiyan, Faye, Vector, Igla, Ruchey, Welrod, Harpsy,
# Monsoon Squad, Mangi Security, The Elmo, Mokosh, Oathguards, Boojum, Doll, Frame,
# Neural cloud, Remolding Pattern.
# Catatan: satu baris di file Inggris masih berbahasa Mandarin
# (这可不是结束……乌琪！ — Vector meneriakkan nama rekan yang langsung menyerbu setelahnya,
# yaitu Ruchey) — diterjemahkan langsung ke Indonesia.
(In the dark tunnel, the Monsoon Squad, having lost Faye, continued to advance.)
column2: (Di terowongan yang gelap, Monsoon Squad yang telah kehilangan Faye terus melangkah maju.)

column1: (Zhaohui and Jiangyu took on the task of clearing obstacles, and the crowd following them was also trying hard to speed up their pace.)
column2: (Zhaohui dan Jiangyu mengambil tugas membabat rintangan, dan rombongan yang mengikuti mereka juga berusaha keras mempercepat langkah.)

column1: (However, perhaps due to the change in the ground battle situation, or perhaps because there were a few more hidden forks along the way, the gunshots that previously only echoed distantly in the tunnel actually sounded closer and closer.)
column2: (Namun, entah karena berubahnya situasi pertempuran di permukaan, atau karena ada beberapa percabangan tersembunyi di sepanjang jalan, suara tembakan yang tadinya hanya bergema jauh di terowongan justru terdengar makin dekat.)

column1: (Bam!)
column2: (Dar!)

column1: (Pop! Pop! Pop!)
column2: (Tar! Tar! Tar!)

column1: (Bang bang bang bang bang!)
column2: (Dor dor dor dor dor!)

column1: (The fast-moving residents no longer made panicked sounds, but the worried expressions on their faces could not be hidden.)
column2: (Warga yang bergerak cepat itu tak lagi mengeluarkan suara panik, tapi kecemasan di wajah mereka tak bisa disembunyikan.)

column1: Sorry, sorry, everyone, now there's only the last stretch of road left! As long as we pass smoothly, everyone will be completely safe!
column2: Maaf, maaf, semuanya, sekarang tinggal ruas jalan terakhir! Asal kita lewat dengan mulus, kalian semua akan benar-benar aman!

column1: Everyone don't worry, even if enemies attack, Monsoon will ensure everyone's safety.
column2: Semuanya jangan cemas, sekalipun musuh menyerang, Monsoon akan menjamin keselamatan kalian.

column1: (Jiangyu tried hard to squeeze out a smile, and Daiyan also gently comforted and promised, but the sound of guns and artillery seemed to be echoing everywhere, and the heavy atmosphere only increased.)
column2: (Jiangyu berusaha keras memeras senyum, dan Daiyan pun menghibur serta menjanjikan dengan lembut, tapi suara senapan dan artileri seakan bergema di segala arah, dan suasana berat itu justru makin menekan.)

column1: Let's change the solution.
column2: Kita ubah caranya.

column1: (Zhaohui stopped in her tracks. She looked at Daiyan and Jiangyu, calmly stating her rational judgment.)
column2: (Zhaohui menghentikan langkahnya. Dia menatap Daiyan dan Jiangyu, menyampaikan penilaian rasionalnya dengan tenang.)

column1: You guys go first, I'll stay.
column2: Kalian duluan, aku yang tinggal.

column1: Wait, Zhaohui, what do you mean?
column2: Tunggu, Zhaohui, apa maksudmu?

column1: You need time to transfer. During this period, I must ensure the passage is completely safe.
column2: Kalian butuh waktu untuk memindahkan mereka. Selama itu, aku harus memastikan lorongnya benar-benar aman.

column1: Compared to me, you are all better at soothing the residents' emotions.
column2: Dibanding aku, kalian lebih pandai menenangkan perasaan warga.

column1: The escort mission needs you more.
column2: Misi pengawalan lebih membutuhkan kalian.

column1: (Zhaohui calmly watched Jiangyu and Daiyan. Under that calm and firm gaze, Jiangyu seemed to have realized something and couldn't help but slowly nod.)
column2: (Zhaohui menatap Jiangyu dan Daiyan dengan tenang. Di bawah tatapan yang tenang dan teguh itu, Jiangyu seakan menyadari sesuatu dan tak kuasa menahan diri untuk mengangguk perlahan.)

column1: Ugh—damn it, I-I hate this kind of scene the most!!
column2: Ugh—sialan, a-aku paling benci adegan seperti ini!!

column1: But you're indeed right. Even if I hate it... I'll listen to you!
column2: Tapi kau memang benar. Sebenci apa pun aku... aku akan menurut padamu!

column1: (Jiangyu stomped her feet, pulled Daiyan and Zhaohui, and stepped in the opposite direction.)
column2: (Jiangyu menghentakkan kaki, menarik Daiyan dan Zhaohui, lalu melangkah ke arah berlawanan.)

column1: Big Sis, let's go! Zhaohui went to lure the enemy away, we can't fall behind either!
column2: Kak, ayo! Zhaohui pergi memancing musuh, kita juga tidak boleh kalah!

column1: Mhm. Leave this side to us.
column2: Mhm. Sisi ini serahkan pada kami.

column1: (Before being pulled away by Jiangyu, Daiyan also nodded seriously to Zhaohui.)
column2: (Sebelum ditarik pergi Jiangyu, Daiyan juga mengangguk serius pada Zhaohui.)

column1: Jiangyu and I will definitely protect everything for you and Faye.
column2: Aku dan Jiangyu pasti akan menjaga semuanya untukmu dan Faye.

column1: Everyone, please follow me—! We're going to speed up a bit!
column2: Semuanya, tolong ikuti aku—! Kita akan sedikit mempercepat langkah!

column1: (Watching the residents head off into the distance with Daiyan and Jiangyu, Zhaohui quickens her pace toward the other end of the passage, taking the fork where the sound of gunfire is clearest.)
column2: (Menyaksikan warga menjauh bersama Daiyan dan Jiangyu, Zhaohui mempercepat langkahnya ke ujung lain lorong, mengambil percabangan tempat suara tembakan paling jelas terdengar.)

column1: (Sure enough, after going tens of meters deep along that fork, a fully armed squad appeared right in the middle of their vision.)
column2: (Benar saja, setelah masuk puluhan meter di percabangan itu, sebuah regu bersenjata lengkap muncul tepat di tengah pandangan.)

column1: (Boom! Boom boom!)
column2: (Buum! Buum buum!)

column1: (What greeted Zhaohui was the sudden roar of artillery, followed immediately by bullets flying towards her.)
column2: (Yang menyambut Zhaohui adalah deru artileri yang mendadak, disusul langsung oleh peluru yang melesat ke arahnya.)

column1: (Bang. Bang. Bang...)
column2: (Dor. Dor. Dor...)

column1: (Zhaohui agilely dodged the artillery fire and bullets, but the underground passage was so narrow, the cover to hide behind so limited, and the enemy's firepower so strong, like an inescapable net pressing down on her.)
column2: (Zhaohui lincah mengelak dari tembakan artileri dan peluru, tapi lorong bawah tanah itu begitu sempit, perlindungannya begitu terbatas, dan daya tembak musuh begitu kuat, bagai jaring tak terelakkan yang menindihnya.)

column1: (--I cannot retreat.)
column2: (--Aku tidak boleh mundur.)

column1: (Zhaohui thought this, then immediately activated her Remolding Pattern, dashed forward, and fired.)
column2: (Zhaohui berpikir begitu, lalu langsung mengaktifkan Remolding Pattern-nya, menerjang maju, dan menembak.)

column1: Perfect. Come at me all together.
column2: Bagus. Serang aku semuanya sekaligus.

column1: (Her bullets and the enemy's bullets intertwined in the narrow passage, while the occasional grenades and artillery shells added a heavy scent of gunpowder to the dense hail of gunfire.)
column2: (Pelurunya dan peluru musuh berjalin di lorong sempit itu, sementara granat dan peluru artileri yang sesekali datang menambahkan bau mesiu yang pekat pada hujan tembakan yang rapat itu.)

column1: (Zhaohui dodged as nimbly as possible, rolling on the ground from time to time, or picking up various fallen pipes, wooden stakes, and iron pieces. All available props were utilized by her, just to entangle this team for a longer time.)
column2: (Zhaohui mengelak selincah mungkin, sesekali berguling di tanah, atau memungut berbagai pipa, tiang kayu, dan potongan besi yang berserakan. Semua benda yang ada dia manfaatkan, semata untuk mengikat regu ini lebih lama.)

column1: (Not enough.)
column2: (Belum cukup.)

column1: (Quickly estimating the time needed for the residents to evacuate, Zhaohui once again increased the operating power of the Remolding Pattern and launched another strong attack towards the enemy.)
column2: (Setelah cepat memperkirakan waktu yang dibutuhkan warga untuk mengungsi, Zhaohui kembali menaikkan daya kerja Remolding Pattern-nya dan melancarkan satu lagi serangan kuat ke arah musuh.)

column1: (But even so, relying on her alone, it was still difficult to resist the attack of an entire elite squad.)
column2: (Tapi meski begitu, hanya mengandalkan dirinya sendiri, tetap sulit menahan serangan satu regu elite penuh.)

column1: Huff...
column2: Hah...

column1: (Can't hold on for much longer.)
column2: (Tidak akan sanggup bertahan lebih lama.)

column1: (Hiding behind the last piece of cover, Zhaohui tried her best to adjust the state of her Frame and Neural cloud.)
column2: (Bersembunyi di balik perlindungan terakhir, Zhaohui berusaha sebisanya menata kembali kondisi Frame dan Neural cloud-nya.)

column1: (The Remolding Pattern had been running continuously for a long time, and her Neural cloud was on the verge of being fused by excessive data.)
column2: (Remolding Pattern-nya sudah berjalan terus-menerus sekian lama, dan Neural cloud-nya nyaris meleleh oleh data yang berlebihan.)

column1: (Her skin was also already covered with burn scars from the flames. In comparison, the once terrifying burn mark on her shoulder seemed so insignificant amidst the burns spreading all over her body at this moment.)
column2: (Kulitnya pun sudah dipenuhi bekas luka bakar dari kobaran api. Dibandingkan itu, bekas luka bakar di bahunya yang dulu tampak mengerikan kini terasa tak berarti di tengah luka bakar yang menyebar ke seluruh tubuhnya.)

column1: (Zhaohui smiled, and paused the operation of the Remolding Pattern one second before her Neural cloud collapsed.)
column2: (Zhaohui tersenyum, dan menghentikan kerja Remolding Pattern-nya satu detik sebelum Neural cloud-nya runtuh.)

column1: (She tried hard to adjust, doing her best to let her Neural cloud quickly return to a suitable temperature and restore its proper clarity.)
column2: (Dia berusaha keras menata diri, sebisa mungkin membuat Neural cloud-nya cepat kembali ke suhu yang layak dan memulihkan kejernihannya.)

column1: (15 seconds, 14 seconds, 13 seconds...)
column2: (15 detik, 14 detik, 13 detik...)

column1: (Time was passing, and not far outside the cover, the Mangi Security enemies threw grenades again, clamoring at her coldly.)
column2: (Waktu terus berjalan, dan tak jauh di luar perlindungan, musuh Mangi Security kembali melempar granat sambil meneriakinya dengan dingin.)

column1: The Doll ahead, you're surrounded! Drop your weapon and cease resistance immediately!
column2: Doll di depan, kau sudah dikepung! Buang senjatamu dan hentikan perlawanan sekarang juga!

column1: I repeat, drop your weapon immediately, cease resistance, and report your unit designation!
column2: Kuulangi, buang senjatamu sekarang, hentikan perlawanan, dan laporkan satuanmu!

column1: (The moment the countdown reached zero, Zhaohui sneered and activated the Remolding Pattern once more.)
column2: (Tepat saat hitung mundurnya mencapai nol, Zhaohui mendengus dan kembali mengaktifkan Remolding Pattern-nya.)

column1: (Grappling hook deployed, short daggers in hand, the cyan shadow was like a gale sweeping through a forest, leaping through the heavy hail of bullets in a mere instant.)
column2: (Kait tambat dilepaskan, belati pendek di tangan, bayangan biru kehijauan itu bagai angin ribut yang menyapu hutan, melompat menembus hujan peluru yang lebat hanya dalam sekejap.)

column1: (Blood splattered, bullets flew from the barrel, and Zhaohui spoke with resounding conviction.)
column2: (Darah muncrat, peluru melesat dari laras, dan Zhaohui bicara dengan keyakinan yang menggema.)

column1: The Elmo Monsoon Squad, Zhaohui, here to fight.
column2: Monsoon Squad Elmo, Zhaohui, hadir untuk bertempur.

column1: (Amidst the boosted morale, the remaining Oathguards once again repelled a round of attacks from Mangi Security.)
column2: (Di tengah semangat yang terangkat, sisa Oathguards sekali lagi memukul mundur satu ronde serangan Mangi Security.)

column1: (Leaning behind cover, the heavily injured soldiers breathed heavily, taking advantage of the brief gap before the enemy continued their attack to get a moment's respite.)
column2: (Bersandar di balik perlindungan, para prajurit yang terluka parah bernapas berat, memanfaatkan jeda singkat sebelum musuh melanjutkan serangan untuk beristirahat sejenak.)

column1: Squad Leader, are we... going to lose...
column2: Ketua Regu, apa kita... akan kalah...

column1: We agreed to earn merit for our squad...
column2: Kita sudah sepakat mau menyumbang jasa untuk regu kita...

column1: H-How could we lose! Didn't I also say I'd treat you guys to drinks!
column2: M-Mana mungkin kita kalah! Bukankah aku juga sudah bilang mau mentraktir kalian minum!

column1: Hold on for me!
column2: Bertahanlah demi aku!

column1: But the enemy has already broken through the fortifications outside the city, even those Doll instructors...
column2: Tapi musuh sudah menembus benteng di luar kota, bahkan para instruktur Doll itu...

column1: Hey, why are you guys starting to say depressing things too?
column2: Hei, kenapa kalian juga mulai bicara yang muram-muram?

column1: This should obviously be my line.
column2: Ini jelas-jelas seharusnya bagianku.

column1: Instructor Vector...
column2: Instruktur Vector...

column1: (Behind the cover next to the Oathguards, the heavily scarred Vector casually replaced the empty magazine in her hand.)
column2: (Di balik perlindungan di sebelah para Oathguard, Vector yang penuh luka mengganti magasin kosong di tangannya dengan santai.)

column1: Things are getting worse and worse... everyone might die or something...
column2: Keadaannya makin lama makin buruk... semua orang mungkin akan mati atau semacamnya...

column1: Ah, as expected, this kind of talk sounds better coming from me.
column2: Ah, memang benar, omongan semacam ini lebih enak didengar kalau keluar dari mulutku.

column1: Haha, then take this opportunity to say it to your heart's content.
column2: Haha, kalau begitu manfaatkan kesempatan ini untuk mengatakannya sepuasmu.

column1: Kid, you speak first.
column2: Nak, kau bicara duluan.
Saya...?

column1: I feel like I might not be able to walk out of Mokosh...
column2: Rasanya saya mungkin tidak akan bisa keluar hidup-hidup dari Mokosh...

column1: At first I thought if I could bring victory to Mokosh, it wouldn't matter even if I died.
column2: Awalnya saya pikir kalau bisa membawa kemenangan untuk Mokosh, mati pun tidak apa-apa.

column1: But I clearly haven't done anything yet... and I'm going to...
column2: Tapi jelas-jelas saya belum melakukan apa-apa... dan saya sudah akan...

column1: Yes, war is like this.
column2: Ya, perang memang begini.

column1: Everyone thinks they will fearlessly march towards the enemy like a hero, bring a glimmer of hope to the people they want to protect, and then die bathed in glory.
column2: Semua orang mengira mereka akan melangkah tanpa takut ke arah musuh bagai pahlawan, membawa secercah harapan bagi orang-orang yang ingin mereka lindungi, lalu mati bermandikan kemuliaan.

column1: But most of the time, those sacrifices on the battlefield... have no meaning at all.
column2: Tapi sebagian besar waktu, pengorbanan-pengorbanan di medan tempur itu... sama sekali tidak bermakna.

column1: Haha... that is indeed the case.
column2: Haha... memang begitu kenyataannya.

column1: I only managed to become this squad leader because I survived the previous battles.
column2: Aku bisa jadi ketua regu ini cuma karena aku selamat di pertempuran-pertempuran sebelumnya.

column1: But Squad Leader, didn't you say... you defeated a Boojum single-handedly before?!
column2: Tapi Ketua Regu, bukankah Anda bilang... Anda pernah mengalahkan Boojum sendirian?!

column1: You even believe bragging? Young people are really easy to fool.
column2: Omong besar begitu kau percaya juga? Anak muda memang gampang ditipu.

column1: Look, this is the truest face of war. There are no legendary tales, only the naked, bloody truth laid bare before our eyes.
column2: Lihat, inilah wajah perang yang paling asli. Tidak ada kisah legenda, cuma kebenaran telanjang dan berdarah yang terhampar di depan mata.

column1: (Vector picked up a plush toy that had fallen beside her.)
column2: (Vector memungut boneka kain yang tergeletak di sebelahnya.)

column1: Ah, it seems its little owner dropped it here while retreating.
column2: Ah, sepertinya pemilik kecilnya menjatuhkannya di sini saat mengungsi.

column1: She should have already evacuated to a safe place under the cover of Monsoon and the others by now, right?
column2: Sekarang dia pasti sudah dipindahkan ke tempat aman di bawah perlindungan Monsoon dan yang lain, kan?

column1: How pitiful, it must have been well-loved, yet it was left behind in a place like this...
column2: Kasihan sekali, pasti dulu disayang, tapi malah ditinggalkan di tempat seperti ini...

column1: (Vector threw the doll, it drew an arc in the air and landed beside the young Oathguard.)
column2: (Vector melempar boneka itu, ia melengkung di udara lalu jatuh di sebelah Oathguard muda tadi.)

column1: Hey, if you have the chance, find its owner and return it to her.
column2: Hei, kalau kau ada kesempatan, cari pemiliknya dan kembalikan padanya.

column1: Make this war... a little more meaningful.
column2: Buat perang ini... sedikit lebih bermakna.

column1: W-what?
column2: A-Apa?

column1: ...What are you going to do!
column2: ...Anda mau apa!

column1: (Vector did not answer.)
column2: (Vector tidak menjawab.)

column1: (She threw the replaced empty magazine on the ground and stood up from behind the cover.)
column2: (Dia melempar magasin kosong yang baru diganti ke tanah dan berdiri dari balik perlindungan.)

column1: The one who should be left behind in this kind of place... should definitely be someone like me.
column2: Yang seharusnya ditinggalkan di tempat semacam ini... jelas orang sepertiku.

column1: (Just as she stands up, a blonde figure wielding a sharp sword is already before her eyes.)
column2: (Tepat saat dia berdiri, sesosok berambut pirang yang menggenggam pedang tajam sudah ada di depan matanya.)

column1: Were you left behind too?
column2: Kau juga ditinggalkan?

column1: I have no way of helping you find your master as well...
column2: Aku juga tidak punya cara membantumu menemukan tuanmu...

column1: (The next second, both Igla and Vector leapt up fiercely, launching attacks at each other's frames.)
column2: (Detik berikutnya, Igla dan Vector sama-sama melompat ganas, melancarkan serangan ke frame satu sama lain.)

column1: (Swish!)
column2: (Swing!)

column1: (Pffft—!)
column2: (Craash—!)

column1: (The gleam of the sword closed in, and a Molotov cocktail traced an arc in the air. Igla dodged the incoming tongues of fire in displeasure and fiercely threw her longsword towards the remaining Molotov cocktails on Vector's arm armor.)
column2: (Kilatan pedang itu mendekat, dan sebotol molotov melengkung di udara. Igla mengelak dari lidah api yang datang dengan kesal dan melempar pedang panjangnya keras-keras ke arah sisa molotov di pelindung lengan Vector.)

column1: (The remaining Molotov cocktails are destroyed in an instant, and the erupting flames force Vector to dodge. In the few short seconds she evades, Igla has already retrieved her deflected longsword and closed in again.)
column2: (Sisa molotov itu hancur seketika, dan kobaran api yang meletus memaksa Vector mengelak. Dalam beberapa detik singkat dia menghindar, Igla sudah mengambil kembali pedang panjangnya yang terpental dan kembali mendekat.)

column1: (The longsword slashes down. Vector raises her gun and fires rapidly at Igla, but the bullets actually miss! Igla dodges the attacks at a speed Vector can't capture, then swiftly closes in on Vector, swinging her sword and stabbing at Vector's arm!)
column2: (Pedang panjang itu menebas turun. Vector mengangkat senjatanya dan menembak cepat ke arah Igla, tapi pelurunya justru meleset! Igla mengelak dengan kecepatan yang tak bisa ditangkap Vector, lalu gesit mendekat, mengayunkan pedangnya dan menusuk lengan Vector!)

column1: N-No!
column2: T-Tidak!

column1: You jerk, say some discouraging words to me at a time like this—!
column2: Dasar kau, coba katakan sesuatu yang melemahkan semangat padaku di saat seperti ini—!

column1: (A burst of intense gunfire rang out, the dense bullets making Igla's sword thrust toward Vector deflect by half an inch—)
column2: (Rentetan tembakan sengit menggelegar, peluru yang rapat itu membuat tusukan pedang Igla ke arah Vector melenceng setengah inci—)

column1: (However, soon enough, a brave human head was severed by that upward-swinging longsword.)
column2: (Namun tak lama kemudian, kepala seorang manusia pemberani terpenggal oleh pedang panjang yang mengayun ke atas itu.)

column1: (Blood snaked its way over, turning Vector's eyes bloodshot.)
column2: (Darah merambat sampai ke sana, membuat mata Vector memerah.)

column1: I clearly just said it...
column2: Padahal jelas-jelas baru saja kubilang...

column1: What is the point... of doing this!!!!
column2: Apa gunanya... melakukan ini!!!!

column1: (Vector took advantage of the opening created by the Oathguards to rush forward, emptying two magazines at Igla in succession.)
column2: (Vector memanfaatkan celah yang diciptakan para Oathguard untuk menerjang maju, mengosongkan dua magasin ke arah Igla berturut-turut.)

column1: (However, the healing speed of the Boojum's flesh was even faster than she imagined—the blood holes shot by bullets healed before blood could even flow out. Her fierce offensive could only create a few seconds of opportunity for her team.)
column2: (Tapi kecepatan pulih daging Boojum itu bahkan lebih cepat dari bayangannya—lubang peluru itu menutup sebelum darah sempat mengalir keluar. Serangan ganasnya hanya sanggup menciptakan peluang beberapa detik bagi timnya.)

column1: (Half an arm and the gun fell to the ground at the same time. Vector's body suddenly lost balance, but just as she was about to fall from the air, Vector fiercely threw a grenade at Igla, and then tightly pounced on Igla, who hadn't gotten far away yet.)
column2: (Separuh lengan dan senjatanya jatuh ke tanah bersamaan. Tubuh Vector mendadak kehilangan keseimbangan, tapi tepat saat hendak jatuh dari udara, Vector melempar granat keras-keras ke arah Igla, lalu menerkam erat Igla yang belum sempat menjauh.)

column1: (*Boom!*)
column2: (*Buum!*)

column1: (The grenade exploded between the two, but Igla grabbed Vector's body and used it to block the bursting flames.)
column2: (Granat itu meledak di antara keduanya, tapi Igla mencengkeram tubuh Vector dan memakainya untuk menahan kobaran api yang meletus.)

column1: A boring drama.
column2: Drama yang membosankan.

column1: (Her incomplete auditory module caught the whisper close at hand, but Vector revealed a faint smile of a successful plan. Without hesitation, she turned around and tightly grabbed Igla with her remaining arm.)
column2: (Modul pendengarannya yang sudah tak utuh menangkap bisikan dari jarak dekat itu, tapi Vector justru menyunggingkan senyum tipis pertanda rencananya berhasil. Tanpa ragu dia berbalik dan mencengkeram Igla erat-erat dengan lengannya yang tersisa.)

column1: 这可不是结束……乌琪！
column2: Ini belum berakhir……Ruchey!

column1: (Taking advantage of the brief visual obstruction when Igla raised the Frame to defend against the explosion, Ruchey raised her gun and charged. Bullets and grenades attacked Igla's front together, while from another direction, Welrod and Harpsy, hiding behind cover, also launched an attack at the same time.)
column2: (Memanfaatkan terhalangnya pandangan sesaat ketika Igla mengangkat Frame itu untuk menahan ledakan, Ruchey mengangkat senjatanya dan menerjang. Peluru dan granat menghantam bagian depan Igla bersamaan, sementara dari arah lain, Welrod dan Harpsy yang bersembunyi di balik perlindungan juga melancarkan serangan di saat yang sama.)

column1: (Bullets and Molotov cocktails from all directions suddenly enveloped Igla. Igla tried to dodge, but Vector's Frame hanging on her arm became an obstruction instead. Igla pulled her arm forcefully, wanting to shake off the obstructive Frame, but Vector beat her to it, hugging the arm and biting down hard.)
column2: (Peluru dan molotov dari segala arah tiba-tiba menyelimuti Igla. Igla berusaha mengelak, tapi Frame Vector yang menggantung di lengannya justru jadi penghalang. Igla menarik lengannya sekuat tenaga, ingin melepas Frame yang mengganggu itu, tapi Vector mendahuluinya, memeluk lengan itu dan menggigitnya kuat-kuat.)

column1: (Pfft! Tissue fluid splattered before her eyes, and Vector firmly fixed herself onto Igla's arm.)
column2: (Cras! Cairan jaringan muncrat di depan matanya, dan Vector mengunci dirinya erat-erat pada lengan Igla.)

column1: (This action suddenly enraged Igla. In just an instant, her other arm forcefully grabbed Vector's neck. The Doll's Frame quickly detached and was thrown off under Igla's exertion, and like a speeding drill, was fiercely chiseled into the wall of the command center building.)
column2: (Tindakan itu seketika membuat Igla murka. Hanya dalam sekejap, lengannya yang lain mencengkeram keras leher Vector. Frame Doll itu cepat terlepas dan terlempar oleh tenaga Igla, lalu bagai bor yang melesat, terhunjam keras ke dinding gedung pusat komando.)

column1: Urgh...!
column2: Argh...!

column1: Even if I turn into a rag doll, it doesn't matter...
column2: Sekalipun aku jadi boneka kain, tidak masalah...

column1: Someone will definitely... deliver me to the Commander!
column2: Pasti ada yang akan... mengantarku ke Komandan!

column1: (Alarms blared sharply in her neural cloud, and Vector's frame completely lost its mobility. But the few short seconds Vector bought still created an opportunity for Ruchey and the others.)
column2: (Sirene melengking tajam di neural cloud-nya, dan frame Vector sepenuhnya kehilangan kemampuan bergerak. Tapi beberapa detik singkat yang dibeli Vector tetap menciptakan peluang bagi Ruchey dan yang lain.)

column1: (Boom! Boom! Boom!)
column2: (Buum! Buum! Buum!)

column1: (Explosions erupted in succession, striking Igla. The continuously blossoming sparks briefly hindered Igla's movements. And taking advantage of Igla's few seconds of pause, Ruchey, Welrod, and Harpsy threw themselves forward together once more.)
column2: (Ledakan meletus berturut-turut, menghantam Igla. Percikan yang terus mekar itu sesaat menghambat gerak Igla. Dan memanfaatkan jeda beberapa detik Igla itu, Ruchey, Welrod, dan Harpsy sekali lagi menerjang maju bersama.)

column1: (There were no words, only a silent and tacitly coordinated attack.)
column2: (Tidak ada kata-kata, hanya serangan yang senyap dan terkoordinasi tanpa perlu diucapkan.)

column1: (The three of them surrounded Igla together, hugged her tightly in the same way, and then ignited the final explosives at the closest distance.)
column2: (Mereka bertiga mengepung Igla bersama-sama, memeluknya erat dengan cara yang sama, lalu menyulut bahan peledak terakhir dari jarak sedekat-dekatnya.)

column1: (Kaboom—!)
column2: (Blaar—!)

column1: (The moment the triple explosion spread, three incomplete Frames flew in different directions with the blast wave. And the third-generation Doll, bound by the bodies of the three, finally received relatively effective damage in the long-dominant engagement.)
column2: (Saat ledakan rangkap tiga itu menyebar, tiga Frame yang tak lagi utuh terlempar ke arah berbeda bersama gelombang ledakan. Dan Doll generasi ketiga yang terkunci oleh tubuh ketiganya itu akhirnya menerima kerusakan yang relatif efektif dalam pertempuran yang selama ini dia dominasi.)

column1: (Igla falls to the ground from the impact. The explosions and burns have left several terrifying scars on her Frame, and one arm has broken off due to the explosion.)
column2: (Igla jatuh ke tanah akibat hantaman itu. Ledakan dan luka bakar menyisakan beberapa bekas mengerikan di Frame-nya, dan satu lengannya patah karena ledakan.)

column1: (Tissue fluid leaks from the wounds covering Igla's body, but after a brief pause, she simply stands up shakily, seemingly tireless.)
column2: (Cairan jaringan merembes dari luka-luka yang memenuhi tubuh Igla, tapi setelah jeda sejenak, dia begitu saja berdiri dengan goyah, seakan tak kenal lelah.)

column1: At...tack...
column2: Se...rang...

column1: (Without hesitation, Igla dragged her incomplete limbs and continued to advance. As she moved forward, those cells invisible to the naked eye wriggled, slowly repairing the damaged limbs.)
column2: (Tanpa ragu, Igla menyeret anggota tubuhnya yang tak lagi utuh dan terus maju. Sambil melangkah, sel-sel yang tak kasatmata itu menggeliat, perlahan memulihkan anggota tubuh yang rusak.)

column1: (In just a few minutes, the blonde Doll's Frame was restored to completeness again.)
column2: (Hanya dalam beberapa menit, Frame Doll berambut pirang itu kembali utuh.)

column1: (She picked up the longsword from the ruins, and together with the attacking Mangi Security troops behind her, turned her gaze to the command center building close at hand—)
column2: (Dia memungut pedang panjangnya dari reruntuhan, dan bersama pasukan Mangi Security yang menyerbu di belakangnya, mengalihkan pandangannya ke gedung pusat komando yang sudah di depan mata—)

column1: (From this moment on, they will launch the final attack.)
column2: (Mulai saat ini, mereka akan melancarkan serangan terakhir.)
